references.text: The Lord commands Moses to give the Levites cities to live in and pasturelands around the cities from the inheritance of the Israelites, which is the original command fulfilled in Joshua 21:3.

The Lord explains that the Levites shall have no inherited portion in the land, but shall receive their share from the other tribes, explaining why they receive cities from the inheritance of the children of Israel.
It confirms that the Levites and the entire tribe of Levi shall have no inheritance among Israel, but shall live by the Lord's fire offerings and his inheritance.
Moses had given an inheritance to the two and a half tribes on the other side of the Jordan, but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them, only cities to live in with pasturelands.
The verse immediately before shows the Levites' request for cities according to the Lord's command through Moses, which verse 3 answers.
It summarizes that the Levites received a total of 48 cities with pasturelands within the property of the children of Israel, fulfilling what begins in verse 3.
A parallel list of the Levitical cities given to the Levites from the various tribes, confirming the fulfillment of the Lord's command.
